Elegant balanced architectural silhouette, bold thick geometry with generous negative space, mirror top/bottom. Particles: small floating red triangular flakes interspersed with tiny rose diamond sparks, close to upper and lower shoulders. Looks like a luminous precision instrument, not feather wings.
